quote: A very strange and solemn feeling came over me as I stood there, with no sound but the rustle of the pines, no one near me, and the sun so glorious, as for me alone.
source: Louisa May Alcott, Her Life, Letters, and Journals, ch. III, Fruitlands, journal entry headed Concord, Thursday (ed. Cheney, 1889)
